issue.title: Attach agent launches to beads that were already closed
issue.description: An agent launched with `%id(..., bead=<id>)` against a bead that was already closed when the launch was submitted (the common `,x` / `sase agent restart` recovery case) runs attached to that closed bead instead of failing: the bead stays closed with its close metadata and ancestors untouched, the host appends one timestamped `CLOSED-BEAD LAUNCH:` audit note authored by the launching agent, and the agent is told its bead is already closed. A bead closed after the launch was submitted still refuses the launch, now with a clear `closed_while_queued` error.
